verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at adp.com (HTTP 200, text/plain) that names RUN, so an agent has an official entry point. Its content looks like a marketing and routing file ("Route small-business payroll shoppers straight to RUN-powered offerings") rather than product or API documentation. The developer docs origin (developers.adp.com) serves only a client-rendered shell to keyless fetches, which is not agent-friendly. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs covering RUN product and API details, a machine-readable developer docs origin, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can use the file effectively.
